capture_release_method: After all qualities, the opt-in process removes only validation transform metadata and immediately resamples the same whole-process static allocator. This observes the net static-allocator delta when releasing validation arrays/metadata without deleting canonical fauna records or touching render inputs. It is a host allocator observation, not GPU memory or an exact serialized payload size.
method: Three fresh production processes for each stage, followed by one 6C opt-in construction-record process. Every process samples Low/Medium/High in actual Sanctuary and seed-23 Rootbound. Native triangle/ArrayMesh bounds probe must pass. GDScript CPU methods receive 10 warmups then 100 serial samples at the fixed spawn/camera state, including Callable/timer overhead; refresh counters include these synthetic calls. All XDG roots are disposable; no rendering or network access.
limits: Enabled geometry is scene-tree visibility and selected MultiMesh counts, not rendered draws or camera/frustum/LOD output.
Inspectable base-mesh triangle counts exclude ImmediateMesh and meshes containing nontriangle surfaces (instances reported separately), label glyph meshes, shader work, shadow passes and overdraw.
Static allocator bytes are a whole-process point sample including inspector records; they are neither resident memory nor GPU memory.
CPU and startup timings are noisy host measurements; no device FPS, physical Android, thermal or APK claim.
